details:
First , the reason why I want this feature , is because of the type of Internet connection I have. My internet connection has a limited amount of data , and there are a lot of people using it ,and as of recently I am reaching the data limit before the month end when it resets . When I checked my data usage in network settings vrchat had a huge usage of about 650 gb.

The VRChat cache seems to delete the older preload of worlds over recent player avatar data preloads . I mostly play on MMD dance worlds  so it's about 1 gb download everytime, and otherwise I visit about 8 other worlds frequently , it would be great if the player avatar cache and world preload cache are seperate , and if we can choose their disk location and size in game (in case disk C: does'nt have enough space) . I have tried to manually increase the cache size to 128gb but it did'nt seem to have any effect, the worlds were still redownloading. I want to permanently save these worlds in my cache so I don't have to re-download them so often, this can save a lot of my internet data,thank you.
title: Permanently Save Worlds in Cache And Choose Cache Disk Location,Size In Game
